oncall-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1 — 5xx > 10% for 2m. Pager: PGR-8123. Severity: potential Sev2. Auto-escalation to oncall at 1779123456.

Alex: got it, I'm paged. looking now, will jump into war room in ~2.

Emily: creating war room + status page draft. pinging @Jordan for owner assignment.

Jordan: I'll take incident owner. creating war-room: https://warrooms.internal.redwood/rooms/ir-2026-03-15-8123

Maria: handing off from night oncall — confirm paging received and rotation. Oncall: @Alex @Jordan please confirm.

Alex: confirmed. first pass on logs looks like model-serving pool (gpu-pool-7) spikes. tail: 
```
[03/15/26 14:10:23] request_id=abc123 model=redwood-ggml status=500 err=kv_cache_miss
[03/15/26 14:10:24] request_id=def456 model=redwood-ggml status=502 backend-timeout
```

Sam: quick question — is this partial or full customer impact? numbers?

Alex: approx ~12% of requests are 5xx, concentrated on long-context (>2048) requests. i'd call it partial degradation for affected workloads.

Jordan: setting Sev2 (degraded). Draft status page copy: 
"Title: Degraded generation in us-east-1. Impact: Some generation requests may fail or have higher latency for long-context calls. Mitigation: rolling warm restarts of gpu-pool-7 and fallback to model variant redwood-ggml-qt."

Emily: posted draft to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/ir-2026-03-15-8123 (internal draft). need approval for public post.

Ops Bot: status page created (ir-2026-03-15-8123). visibility: internal draft. will publish to public once approved.

Maria: Jordan = owner, please confirm mitigation plan and who runs the restarts. i'll take notes and preserve logs for postmortem. tagging @sre-rotations.

Jordan: I'll coordinate. Alex + Maria do rolling restarts, Sam monitors metrics, Emily handles customer comms. If restarts don't help in 10m, failover traffic to us-west.

Alex: starting rolling restart on gpu-pool-7 node node-7a (1/6).

Emily: customer communication templates (pick one):
1) Short: "We're seeing elevated errors for generation in us-east-1. We're investigating; no action needed on your side."
2) Detailed: "Some requests to generation endpoints may return errors for long-context calls. We're rolling restarts and enabling fallback variants. ETA ~30m. We'll update shortly."

Sam: dashboard snapshot: control-plane error rate spiked to 14% at 14:11. i'll paste images in war room.

oncall-bot: reminder: paging acknowledgement required within 5m. Alex acknowledged at 1779123460.

Jordan: noted. if restarts don't reduce errors within 10m, we'll failover traffic to us-west region.

Maria: preserving logs and runbook steps for postmortem. please avoid deleting nodes until i archive artifacts.

sre-rotations: added rotation notes and ownership marker.

Alex: restart progress: 3/6 complete. local errors on restarted nodes down to ~6%.

Sam: global error rate down to 7.8% — trending down. continuing to monitor.

Jordan: good progress. Emily, please send the customer-facing (detailed) update now.

Emily: posted update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/ir-2026-03-15-8123/updates/1 — message includes current impact, mitigation steps (rolling restarts + fallback), and ETA 30m. cc: support.

Ops Bot: customer notifications queued and sent for impacted accounts based on impact matrix.

Alex: completing final restarts now (6/6). observing reduction to baseline ~0.3% 5xx.

Jordan: declaring mitigation complete. entering monitoring/observability phase. postmortem lead = Maria.

Maria: ack. i'll start the postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/ir-2026-03-15-8123 and gather logs, dashboard snapshots, and the rollout notes.

oncall-bot: incident status updated to "Mitigated" at 1779123678. will move status page to public in 15m unless objections.

Alex: leaving a short todo list in the war room: reproduce locally for seq>2048, verify kv-cache logic, add canary for model-variant fallback, update runbook.

Emily: thanks team — i'll circulate the customer email thread and add support notes. :thumbsup:

Jordan: great work. i'll open the postmortem ticket and schedule a 30m follow-up in 24h.

Maria: closing notes: preserve all artifacts, include exact restart sequence, and note that fallback variant prevented a larger outage.
